scraped.scraped_description: Somos una organización latinoamericana que lucha por la transformación de las democracias.

name: Fundación Ciudadanía Inteligente
tagline: Latin American organization fighting for the transformation of democracies through civic technology and open tools
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Geographic concentration in Chile with expansion challenges
awards: Fundación Carolina Award for Innovation in Civic Technology (2018)

policy_outcomes.description: Transparentes platform tracks legislative compliance in Chile
Del Dicho Al Hecho monitors government fulfillment of legislative promises
Acción Climática measures Chile's compliance with climate change commitments under the Climate Change Framework Law

outcome_methodology: Mixed methods approach combining platform usage analytics, stakeholder interviews, and policy document analysis
published_performance_metrics: Annual impact reports available on website documenting platform usage, legislative changes tracked, and civic engagement metrics
documented_limitations: Limited quantitative evidence of direct policy causation
Challenges in measuring long-term democratic impact
Geographic variation in platform adoption and effectiveness
failure_modes: Platform adoption barriers in countries with limited digital infrastructure
Political resistance in less democratic contexts
curation_criteria: Focus on tools that enhance government transparency, citizen participation, and democratic accountability; priority given to open-source solutions and regional relevance
contributor_governance: Open contribution model with community guidelines; board includes civil society representatives and regional partners
disparity_tracking: Monitors digital access disparities and inclusion of marginalized communities in civic participation initiatives
community_ownership: Strong emphasis on local ownership through partnerships with regional civil society organizations and community co-design processes

elections_used_in.role: Tú Decides campaign for voter information

government_partnerships.nature: Legislative monitoring and climate compliance tracking
Abre Alcaldías program for open local governance

ai_involvement: Alianza por Algoritmos Inclusivos (Alliance for Inclusive Algorithms) - global alliance to combat AI bias
political_relevance_summary: Fundación Ciudadanía Inteligente addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. Latin American organization fighting for the transformation of democracies through civic technology and open tools.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizing, campaigning, or advocacy actions.

generalizability_notes: Highly generalizable; already deployed across multiple countries. Open-source codebase facilitates replication.
